presentation.name: Prepare a semantic model so Copilot answers from the measures you defined
presentation.summary: Decides what Power BI Copilot can bind a question to, and checks that an answer or a drafted measure used the measure that was meant.
benefits: Reads hidden flags, summarizeBy, descriptions, synonyms, roles, and the date-table mark from the TMDL, and stops when those files are not there
Hides a column when a measure is the metric, or sets summarizeBy to none if it must stay visible, so the answer is not the sum of a key, a rate, or a pre-aggregated total
Uses the measure description as the only definition, including grain, filters, unit, and what the metric is not
Treats a bidirectional relationship and a second date as different numbers, not as style
Names the role a check was run as, because a role that sees everything is a different population
Sends a drafted measure to the SQL-and-DAX equivalence check instead of accepting prose that sounds right
